subject: Post-call recap: Avery Technologies — decision anchors & ops checklist
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@averytech.com>, Avery Tech Procurement <procurement@averytech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Avery Technologies — decision anchors & ops checklist

Hi Priya (and team),

Thanks again for the time today — useful conversation. Wanted to summarize what we heard, confirm priority outcomes, and put a short ops/procurement checklist on your radar so everyone is aligned. If anything below is off, please flag and we’ll adjust.

Key pain points you reiterated
- Production latency spikes during hourly batch inference windows (current 400–800ms p50 for standard text-gen flows).
- Unpredictable per-token costs with current cloud setup — finance needs predictable unit economics.
- Need for strong audit & retention controls for regulated data (retention policy, immutable logs).

Stated goals / decision anchors
1) Consistent p50 latency under ~200ms for user-facing calls at 99th percentile SLA window.
2) Predictable monthly spend with reserved capacity or committed throughput.
3) SOC 2 evidence, KMS integration, and an auditable retention policy before production go-live.
4) Pilot with sanitized production traffic (rollout can start with 1 region and 75% of traffic).

Procurement & ops checklist (next artifacts we’ll provide)
- Draft SOW with pilot success criteria and proposed pricing (attached: SOW_draft_v1.pdf).
- Security evidence packet: SOC2 summary + logs export schema (we’ll push security-evidence.xlsx by EOD Monday).
- Deployment options memo: hosted vs dedicated vs private (quick pros/cons for your infra team).

Immediate asks / next steps
- Priya: confirm decision-maker timeline (you mentioned late May). Is that still accurate?
- Procurement: please share PO cadence and standard terms we should expect (net 30 vs net 45, required insurance clauses).
- Rishi & Lauren (internal): I asked for a pilot pricing carve and an ops checklist we can hand to their infra leads — can you draft by Tue, 27 Apr?
- Schedule: propose 30-min follow-up with Avery exec + procurement on Thu, 29 Apr at 09:30 PT to align on timeline and sign-off owners.

Attachments: [Attachment: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks — Connor

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@averytech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Tech Procurement <procurement@averytech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Avery Technologies — decision anchors & ops checklist

Connor — thanks for the clear recap. Couple quick clarifications and a note on timeline.

On priorities: we do need the p50 latency target met for the customer-facing flows (priority A). The batch window degradation is priority B — we can accept a slightly higher tail on batch if the user-facing SLA holds.

Procurement timeline: internal procurement committee meets 10 May, final exec approval targeted for 24 May. Given that, we are aiming to kick a pilot the week of 7 Jun. If you can have the SOW and security packet over by 29 Apr, that will help us slot your pilot in the queue.

Security ask: can you confirm whether Redwood supports HSM-backed KMS and whether logs are immutable for 180 days? We’ll route a short questionnaire to your security team if needed.

Procurement contact: procurement@averytech.com (CC’d) — they will loop in legal once we have the pricing and SOW.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Desai
Head of Product (GenAI) | Avery Technologies
priya.desai@averytech.com | +1 212-555-7654

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Tech Procurement <procurement@averytech.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Avery Technologies — decision anchors & ops checklist

Priya / Connor — appreciate the clear alignment. Quick answers and a proposed pilot framework.

Security: yes — Redwood supports HSM-backed KMS via our KMS integrations (we’ll include IAM/role docs). Logs are exported to an append-only store by default; retention can be configured to 180 days. We’ll include an export sample in security-evidence.xlsx.

Pilot proposal (high level)
- Length: 6 weeks (2-week onboarding + 4-week validation).
- Traffic: start with 10% user-facing traffic in US-West, scale to 75% if we meet latency and error targets.
- Success criteria: p50 <200ms, error rate <0.5% for instrumented flows, and cost per 1M tokens within agreed band.
- Pricing: tiered reserved capacity for pilot (we can commit to a minimum monthly spend and drop to pay-as-you-go if you pause). Will send numbers in a short follow-up.

Procurement: Connor, I’ll draft a pilot pricing carve and an SOW appendix for the onboarding milestones. Lauren — can you take point on the billing terms and produce a standard payment clause (net 30 / net 45 options) by Tue?

Next call: Thu 29 Apr 09:30 PT works for us — I’ll block once Connor confirms.

Attachment: [Attachment: security-evidence.xlsx (XLSX) — outgoing; will add export sample]

Thanks, Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions & Strategy 
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Internal: Avery pathing & escalation items (for leadership)

Team — quick internal note summarizing owners and escalation routes so we don’t lose momentum. I’ll forward the external confirmations to exec sponsor once we have updated SOW and pricing.

Action owners
- Rishi: SOW appendix + pilot pricing (deliver Tue 27 Apr EOD).
- Lauren: billing & terms options (net 30 / net 45 + insurance clause language) — deliver Tue 27 Apr EOD.
- Connor: schedule Thu 29 Apr 09:30 PT follow-up with Priya + procurement; prepare a 10-min executive summary for Avery’s VP of Eng ahead of the call.
- Security: ask security team to finalize the security-evidence.xlsx sample by Mon EOD and confirm HSM/KMS wording (I’ll loop them after this).

Escalation items (if procurement or legal push back)
- Executive sponsor: Priya (Head of Product) — primary decision driver.
- If we hit legal delay on standard terms, escalate to our Sales Lead (Lauren) + Redwood Legal (cc to be added).
- If pilot SLA targets aren’t met during onboarding, we propose a 30-day rollback window and a working group to tune model runtime/quantization.

Notes: I’ll upload the SOW draft and the security packet to the HubSpot deal and share DocuSign link once SOW is approved.

Connor
